messages:
alex: Hey team — spinning up a new GCP project for an internal inference staging pool. Need quota increases and project activation so infra can provision H100s for dedicated testing and L4s for canary traffic. Project: redwood-infer-staging-23, project number 987654321012. Billing: linked to account BA-334455. Regions: us-central1 (H100), europe-west4 (L4), asia-southeast1 (burst L4). Can someone start the approval path and request quota increases?

maria: Quick Q — estimated monthly GPU hours? finance needs a ballpark to approve billing exceptions.

alex: Rough estimate: 6 H100s @ 720h/mo = 4320h; 12 L4s @ 720h/mo = 8640h. Assume 20% preemption buffer for burst pools. Monthly committed spend estimate ~ $85k (back of napkin). Will refine.

raj: I can kick off the quota requests. Need these quota types from GCP: "GPU (all regions)" accelerators for H100, quota for L4 accelerators, and CPU/GPU EGRESS limits for europe-west4. Also need to enable compute.googleapis.com and service networking for private IPs.

raj: Steps I will take: 1) open console quota request with project number; 2) add justification + expected sustained usage; 3) request increases for these specific SKUs and for 'External IP addresses' if we need EIPs for spot pools; 4) request 'Interconnect egress' increase for cross-region traffic.

alex: FYI we will want VPC peering to our analytics VPC for metrics ingestion — that will require VPC peering quotas and maybe private service connect. Add that to the request.

sasha: Heads up — for private deployments in europe-west4 we need KMS access and HSM integration allowed. Is that in scope? If not, we should create a separate ticket.

alex: Not for this sprint, keep HSM separate. For now only compute + quotas + EIP.

ops-bot: @raj — remember to include the support case template: project number, billing account, exact accelerator types (H100, L4), desired per-region counts, and business justification referencing staging->prod rollover testing. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas

raj: Drafting message now. I'll use this payload:
```
Project: 987654321012
Billing account: BA-334455
Requested regions: us-central1 (H100: +6 GPUs), europe-west4 (L4: +12 GPUs), asia-southeast1 (L4 burst: +6 GPUs)
Other quotas: External IPs +50, Inter-region egress +5 TB, Compute API enabled
Justification: Provisioning a small dedicated staging cluster to validate multi-region routing, failover, and quantized model performance before Dedicated GA rollout. Critical for SLA tests.
Cost estimate: ~$85k/mo initial.
```

maria: Please tag the request with billing owner 'maria' and product owner 'alex' so approvals route correctly. Finance will sign off if we limit external IPs and commit to review after 30 days.

raj: Done. Filed quota request (case 2026-QUOTA-8123). ETA from GCP support looks like 3-5 business days. Linking the case: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/2026-QUOTA-8123

alex: Thanks. Two follow-ups: 1) Assign a service account that infra will use to create instances (sa-infer-staging@redwood-infer.iam.gserviceaccount.com) and 2) after quota is granted, can someone confirm VPC route for peering and whether we need additional peering IP ranges?

raj: I'll create the SA and grant roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1 + roles/iam.serviceAccountUser. Also will run the preflight script to check regional quotas and network ranges. Preflight command:
```
gcloud compute project-info describe --project=987654321012
gcloud compute regions describe us-central1 --project=987654321012
```

sasha: If quotas come back limited for H100, we should have fallback to A100 with quantization profile Q2.0 to keep tests going. Add fallback plan in the ticket.

alex: Good call. Add fallback note in the support case.

ops-bot: Case 2026-QUOTA-8123 updated: added fallback to A100, added SA and billing tags. Status: Pending - GCP review.

kelly: Finance ack :+1:. Approving provisional billing for this staging pool conditional on 30-day usage review and tagging of all external IPs.

raj: Marking checklist items: created SA, filed case, added peering note, included cost estimate. Will circle back when quota is approved and then we do infra provisioning runbook.

alex: Thanks everyone — will wait for confirmation. If GCP asks for any additional justification ping me directly.
